test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Skill India is an initiative launched by the government in ________ to train over 40 crore Indians in different industry-related jobs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Skill India is an initiative launched by the Government of India in 2015 to provide training and skill development to over 40 crore Indians in different industry-related jobs.**
 
• The objective of Skill India is to create a workforce that is** skilled, certified, and employable, and to bridge the gap between the demand and supply of skilled manpower in various sectors of the economy.**
 
• Skill India is a part of the **National Skill Development Mission, which was launched in 2015 **with the aim of creating a skilled workforce of 500 million people by 2022.
 
• Skill India offers various training programs and courses in partnership with industry bodies, training institutes, and other stakeholders, and provides financial assistance to candidates through various schemes and programs.
 
• The other options, i.e., 2010, 2012, and 2017, are incorrect as Skill India was launched in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)** is the **implementing agency** for Skill India, and various ministries, such as the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Ministry of Rural Development, Ministry of Labour and Employment, etc., are involved in the initiative.
 
• Skill India covers various sectors, including **agriculture, healthcare, construction, tourism and hospitality, retail, automotive, electronics, beauty and wellness, etc.**
 
• The government has set up various institutions and programs under Skill India, such as Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), Skill Loan Scheme, etc.
 
• Skill India aims to provide a platform for the youth of the country to acquire skills that are in demand globally and to make India the skill capital of the world.
